title: AI Medical Interpretation Rollout Guide
summary: A 90-day AI medical interpretation rollout guide covering pilot design, baseline metrics, staff adoption, escalation, EHR workflow, and expansion gates.
body_markdown:
###


Start in one unit or clinic with frequent interpreted encounters, a stable team, clear device ownership, and enough volume to compare before and after. Collect baseline data before go-live and set expansion gates in advance.


###


A 30 to 90 day window is often long enough to test adoption, workflow friction, language mix, quality flags, escalation, and cost across repeated real encounters. The right duration depends on encounter volume.


###


Track interpreter use per eligible encounter, time to active interpretation, language mix, quality flags, human escalation, staff feedback, patient feedback, cost per completed interpreted encounter, and language-related safety reports.


###


Not always. A pilot can first test use, quality, and workflow on existing devices. Deeper EHR work can follow once the organization knows which workflows and data connections are worth building.


###


Expand after the pilot meets predefined gates such as stable interpreter use, acceptable quality, clear escalation, manageable launch time, consistent documentation, and no unresolved high-severity safety issue.
